items.check: test -f pyproject.toml && test -f src/ki_review/__init__.py && uv sync --frozen && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run pyright
items.detail: Scaffold minimal Python layout with uv: package src/ki_review, tests/, pyproject.toml with ruff (E,F,I,B,UP) and pyright strict, dev deps pytest/ruff/pyright. No app code yet, only structure plus locked deps.
items.title: Toolchain scaffold Python uv package layout

items.detail: Add GitHub Actions workflow .github/workflows/ci.yml on pull_request and push to main with paths-ignore plans/**, running full gate: pytest, ruff check, ruff format --check, pyright.
items.title: GitHub Actions CI with test and lint gate

items.check: test -f Dockerfile && test $(grep -c "^FROM" Dockerfile) -ge 2 && grep -q "AS test" Dockerfile
items.detail: Add multi-stage Dockerfile: base, test stage running the suite, final runtime stage exposing 8000. No app copy tricks, deterministic builds.
items.title: Multi-stage Dockerfile with test stage

items.detail:
Create FastAPI app factory in src/ki_review/app.py with GET /health returning {"status": "ok"}. Typed, no business logic.
Produces: create_app() -> FastAPI
items.title: FastAPI app factory with health endpoint

items.detail:
Add typed settings module src/ki_review/config.py reading env (HOST, PORT, GITHUB_TOKEN optional) with defaults. No secrets stored.
Produces: get_settings() -> Settings
items.title: Typed settings and logging base

items.detail:
Add domain models src/ki_review/models.py: FileDiff, Finding, ReviewRequest, ReviewReport as pydantic/dataclasses with severity enum. Helper constructor used by all checks.
Produces: build_finding(code: str, message: str, severity: str, path: str, line: int) -> Finding
items.title: Domain models for findings and reports

items.detail:
Add unified diff parser src/ki_review/diff.py handling multi-file diffs, hunks, line numbers, empty and malformed input with typed errors.
Produces: parse_unified_diff(text: str) -> list[FileDiff]
items.title: Unified diff parser for multi-file PRs

items.detail:
Add GitHub PR fetcher src/ki_review/github.py: given a PR URL return unified diff text via API, GITHUB_TOKEN from env for private repos, public works unauthenticated, typed HTTP errors.
Produces: fetch_pr_diff(url: str) -> str
items.title: GitHub PR diff fetcher with token support

items.detail:
Add static checks engine src/ki_review/checks.py orchestrating all dimensions over parsed files, deterministic and offline.
Consumes: build_finding(code: str, message: str, severity: str, path: str, line: int) -> Finding
Produces: run_static_checks(files: list[FileDiff]) -> list[Finding]
items.title: Static checks engine orchestrating dimensions

items.detail:
Add security checks: SQL injection via string formatting, hardcoded secrets, unsafe defaults, missing timeouts.
Consumes: build_finding(code: str, message: str, severity: str, path: str, line: int) -> Finding
Produces: check_security(files: list[FileDiff]) -> list[Finding]
items.title: Security checks for injection and secrets

items.detail:
Add hallucinated-API checks against installed Python stdlib and pinned deps: unknown imports, removed pandas-style APIs, version guards.
Consumes: build_finding(code: str, message: str, severity: str, path: str, line: int) -> Finding
Produces: check_hallucinated_apis(files: list[FileDiff]) -> list[Finding]
items.title: Hallucinated API detection for Python deps

items.detail:
Add quality checks: missing tests for new branches, swallowed exceptions, N+1/blocking patterns, copy-paste duplicates, dead code.
Consumes: build_finding(code: str, message: str, severity: str, path: str, line: int) -> Finding
Produces: check_tests_and_errors(files: list[FileDiff]) -> list[Finding]
items.title: Test quality error handling and duplication checks

items.detail:
Add report builder src/ki_review/report.py sorting findings by severity, attaching file and line anchors.
Consumes: build_finding(code: str, message: str, severity: str, path: str, line: int) -> Finding
Consumes: run_static_checks(files: list[FileDiff]) -> list[Finding]
Consumes: check_security(files: list[FileDiff]) -> list[Finding]
Consumes: check_hallucinated_apis(files: list[FileDiff]) -> list[Finding]
Consumes: check_tests_and_errors(files: list[FileDiff]) -> list[Finding]
Produces: build_report(request: ReviewRequest, findings: list[Finding]) -> ReviewReport
items.title: Review report builder with severity sorting

items.detail:
Add in-memory report store src/ki_review/store.py with uuid ids for demo scope, no DB.
Produces: save_report(report: ReviewReport) -> str
Produces: get_report(report_id: str) -> ReviewReport
items.title: In-memory review report store

Consumes: get_settings() -> Settings

items.detail: Add single-page HTML UI with diff view, severity badges, clickable file:line anchors, PR URL and diff-paste forms. Server-rendered, no JS build step.
items.title: Single-page HTML diff and findings UI

items.detail: Add JSON API plus typed error responses for bad URL, empty diff, oversized payload, GitHub 404/rate-limit, with consistent error schema.
items.title: JSON API and typed error responses

Add golden-path sample fixture tests/fixtures/sample.diff with known findings for demo and smoke. Loader used by final check.

Final smoke proving DoD: multi-stage build, /health reachable, golden sample reviewable via UI. Uses fixture loader for manual verification.
